source_info.dataset_name: Analytics Engineering – SaaS Subscriptions & Customer Churn Dataset v1.0.0

source_coverage.label_observability_assumption: Negative churn labels (ended_at IS NULL or ended_at > window_end_date) assume complete event capture through declared cutoff date 2025-12-31 without right-censoring unobserved cancellations.

cohort_inclusion_rules.rule: started_at <= OBSERVATION_DATE and (ended_at IS NULL or ended_at > OBSERVATION_DATE)
cohort_inclusion_rules.description: Subscriptions active at the end of day on 2024-12-31.
exclusions: Subscriptions ended on or before 2024-12-31 (already churned)

metadata_columns.name: subscription_id
metadata_columns.description: Unique subscription primary key identifier. For record lineage only; must not be fed to ML models.

metadata_columns.name: account_id
metadata_columns.description: Unique account identifier associated with the subscription (1:1 in modeling cohort). For record lineage only.

feature_columns.name: region
feature_columns.description: Geographical region of account (e.g. APAC, EMEA, LATAM). Nulls are preserved as true missing values. Assumed invariant across subscription lifecycle.
feature_columns.missing_value_policy: Preserve NULL without imputation. Unobserved confounders cannot be ruled out.

feature_columns.name: region_missing_flag
feature_columns.description: Binary flag indicating whether account region is missing (1 = missing, 0 = observed).

feature_columns.name: segment
feature_columns.description: Company size segment (SMB, Mid-Market, Enterprise). Assumed invariant across subscription lifecycle; historical company scaling logs are absent.

feature_columns.name: acquisition_channel
feature_columns.description: Initial marketing acquisition channel (e.g. organic, paid, partner, referral, outbound). Point-in-time invariant.

feature_columns.name: account_age_days_at_t0
feature_columns.description: Number of elapsed calendar days from account creation (created_at) to observation date T0 (2024-12-31).
feature_columns.missing_value_policy: Nullable Int64; 0 missing values in verified cohort.

feature_columns.name: account_created_at_missing_flag
feature_columns.description: Binary indicator for missing account creation date (1 = missing, 0 = present).

feature_columns.name: subscription_tenure_days_at_t0
feature_columns.description: Number of elapsed calendar days from subscription start (started_at) to observation date T0 (2024-12-31). Leakage-free tenure.

feature_columns.name: subscription_start_month
feature_columns.description: Calendar month (1-12) of subscription start date.

feature_columns.name: subscription_start_quarter
feature_columns.description: Calendar quarter (1-4) of subscription start date.

feature_columns.name: plan_name
feature_columns.description: Subscribed pricing tier name (Starter, Growth, Scale, Enterprise). Assumed invariant across subscription lifecycle; historical plan change and upgrade/downgrade event logs are absent in source data.

feature_columns.name: plan_monthly_price
feature_columns.description: Monthly list price of the subscribed plan from plans table. Assumed invariant across subscription period; historical pricing change logs or plan tier version records are absent in source data.

feature_columns.name: plan_included_seats
feature_columns.description: Number of user seats included by default in the subscribed plan tier. Assumed invariant across subscription period; historical plan packaging or seat quota revision logs are absent in source data.

target_columns.name: target_churn_90d
target_columns.description: Subscription churned within 90 days after observation date.

target_columns.name: target_churn_180d
target_columns.description: Subscription churned within 180 days after observation date.

target_columns.name: target_churn_365d
target_columns.description: Subscription churned within 365 days after observation date.

excluded_columns.name: ended_at
excluded_columns.reason: Directly encodes future cancellation event and timing occurring after T0. Only used to define cohort and target labels.

excluded_columns.name: status
excluded_columns.reason: Encodes final lifecycle status of subscription at dataset cutoff (2025-12-31), contaminating T0 prediction with future state.

excluded_columns.name: churn
excluded_columns.reason: EDA churn label based on status == 'cancelled' over full 2023-2025 period; constitutes direct label leakage.

excluded_columns.name: tenure_days
excluded_columns.reason: Calculated in EDA using ended_at - started_at for cancelled accounts, which leaks post-T0 survival duration.

excluded_columns.name: seats
excluded_columns.reason: Purchased seats count lacks temporal event audit logging. Documentation does not verify whether value is fixed at start or reflects post-T0 expansions.

excluded_columns.name: mrr
excluded_columns.reason: Contracted MRR lacks historical change tracking. Unverified whether value reflects T0 status or subsequent modifications.

excluded_columns.name: additional_seats
excluded_columns.reason: Derived from seats - included_seats; subject to the same temporal unverified status as seats.

excluded_columns.name: total_invoices
excluded_columns.reason: Invoices cover only ~6% of subscriptions. Aggregates in EDA cover post-T0 invoices, creating leakage and severe population bias.

excluded_columns.name: total_payment_attempts
excluded_columns.reason: Payment data restricted to 120 subscriptions. Excluded from baseline feature matrix to maintain generalizability.

excluded_columns.name: total_payment_failures
excluded_columns.reason: Restricted billing cohort feature. Excluded from baseline matrix; reserved for specialized billing-cohort experiments.

excluded_columns.name: payment_failure_rate
excluded_columns.reason: Restricted billing cohort feature. Excluded from baseline matrix.

excluded_columns.name: total_amount_billed
excluded_columns.reason: Restricted billing cohort feature. Excluded from baseline matrix.

excluded_columns.name: total_amount_paid
excluded_columns.reason: Restricted billing cohort feature. Excluded from baseline matrix.

excluded_columns.name: has_billing_data
excluded_columns.reason: Cohort membership indicator. Excluded from baseline feature matrix.

excluded_columns.name: has_payment_data
excluded_columns.reason: Cohort membership indicator. Excluded from baseline feature matrix.

excluded_columns.name: account_id
excluded_columns.reason: Record tracking identifier. Excluded from feature space to prevent arbitrary ID memorization.

excluded_columns.name: subscription_id
excluded_columns.reason: Primary key identifier. Excluded from feature space to prevent arbitrary ID memorization.

missing_value_policy.region: Keep raw NULL (321 rows in cohort). Do not impute with mean/mode/synthetic categories. Indicator flag created.
missing_value_policy.created_at: Keep raw date; flag created if missing. 0 missing in cohort.
missing_value_policy.categorical_handling: String values preserved without one-hot or ordinal encoding.
